messages:
Michelle: Reminder: all-hands Fri 10:00am PT. Agenda: incident recap + ops learnings, Redwood Optimize roadmap (GA timing + canary plan), hosted API data-retention policy changes, QA and open mic. Drop questions here or in #all-hands-questions by Thu EOD.
Devin: Will you display the exact policy wording? we need to confirm implications for Dedicated customers.
Michelle: Yes  we'll show the revised retention text. No uptime SLA changes; this updates default retention windows and export timing for Hosted API.
Raj: Does this impact Private (VPC/on-prem)?
Michelle: Private remains customer-managed. Dedicated customers can contract custom retention terms.
Sarah: Can we get a short FAQ slide targeted at CS/sales?
Emily: I'll draft the FAQ slide; DM me urgent items.
OpsBot: Incident 2026-03-18-14: partial outage in us-west caused by autoscaler bug, ~22m; postmortem draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/2026-03-18-14.
Jorge: Please include mitigation timeline and follow-up action owners in the incident section.
Samir: I'll add the rollout checklist and the autoscaler snippet to the slides.
Michelle: Good note  we'll include mitigation steps and the checklist excerpt.
Devin: Any update to customer comms templates after the outage?
Sarah: Comms updated the template; will share ahead of the meeting.
Raj: Enterprise customers asked about export SLAs; can we add a slide on export process and timing?
Michelle: Added.
Emily: Product: what's the expected GA window for Optimize? month/week helps sales.
Michelle: Target: June GA window; we'll show canary milestones.
Devin: I'll bring pricing questions re: Dedicated burst capacity.
Samir: Posting the autoscaler code snippet into incident slides.
Sarah: Logistics: mute on entry, cameras encouraged. Run ~40m briefing + 15m Q&A. Use Q&A panel or raise hand.
Michelle: If you can't attend, mark regrets; we'll send recording.
Jorge: Please ensure slides have alt text; design will assist.
Emily: Confirmed accessibility checks.
Michelle: Action items: Emily (FAQ & accessibility), Samir (rollout checklist), Sarah (comms template), Devin (pricing questions), Ops (finalize postmortem link).
Sarah: TL;DR: incident resolved; postmortem up for review. Hosted API retention defaults changing (no uptime SLA change). Optimize target: June GA + canary plan. Dedicated/Private unaffected by defaults; export and contract options available. Slides + recording posted after meeting.
Devin: +1 TL;DR.
Michelle: Placeholder recording link (will post after meeting): https://zoom.redwood/recording/efgh5678
OpsBot: Reminder: review incident draft and leave comments by Thu 5pm PT.
Emily: Draft FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/all-hands/faq-draft (comments welcome).
Raj: I'll add export SLA details.
Samir: Thanks team. :thumbsup: 
Michelle: Closing thread  add late questions to #all-hands-questions or DM me.
